decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 61_P_19 Rev B; 61_P_20 Rev I; 61_P_21 Rev F; 61_P_22 Rev G; 61_P_23 Rev G; 61_P_24 Rev C; 61_P_35 Rev G; 61_P_36 Rev H; 61_P_37 Rev C; 61_P_38 Rev A; 61_P_50 Rev C; 61_P_51 Rev B; 3683/L/02.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and polices DH1 and DH2 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2025-2040. 
Condition : 4 - Obscure glazing



The obscured glazing to the north-facing side of the dormer, as shown on the hereby approved drawings, shall be installed prior to occupation of the development and shall thereafter be permanently retained as such and shall not be replaced with clear glazing or any other form of glazing that would increase overlooking.



Reason: In order to prevent unreasonable overlooking and loss of privacy to neighbouring residential occupiers and to safeguard residential amenity, in accordance with Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Enclosure of lightwell at basement level, changes to courtyard garden, side dormer extension and associated works including changes to windows and brick detailing.
